name: Nakatsu Shizuru
source: [url=/c267]Kotarou's[/url] kouhai. She has a reserved and honest disposition. Even if she doesn't speak, she is able to convey herself through her behavior; she has rich facial expressions. Although a member of the Disciplinary Committeee, she rarely acts like one, besides as a pretext for looking after Kotarou. She fawns over her favorite dish, saury.
